about: Hand-made just-chatting stream: a chat question answered with a story, a brb gap, a cat story.

segments.text: Hey everyone, welcome in, grab a seat.
Let me read some chat messages real quick.
Someone asked why I quit my office job.
Honestly, it was the printer.
That printer jammed every single morning for three years.
One day it jammed on my resignation letter.
So I took that as a sign from the universe.
And I walked out and never looked back.
Best decision I ever made.
Okay, I need to get some water, one second.
Be right back.
Okay, I'm back.
Somebody donated five dollars, thank you so much.
They said my cat is the real streamer here.
Which, honestly, is fair.
Yesterday my cat walked across the keyboard.
She muted me for ten whole minutes.
And nobody in chat told me!
Ten minutes of me talking to nobody.
You guys are the worst, I love you.
Alright, let's play some games.

good.why: the question, the printer story, the exit
cat on the keyboard, ten muted minutes
